name: biceps-curl-stability-ball-with-medicine-ball
title: Biceps Curl: Stability Ball with Medicine Ball
primer: This exercise combines a new technology, Stability Ball, with an old piece of fitness equipment, the Medicine Ball.
steps: Sit on a Stability Ball with your feet firmly on the floor in front of you.
Sit with your back straight, your shoulders back and your abs drawn in.
Hold a Medicine Ball in one hand and curl it up bringing your forearm up to your biceps.
Return to the starting position and switch arms.
tips: Grasp the Medicine Ball with your fingers spread wide to balance the ball.
